text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I was walking through the 
shopping mall—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mar~ve~lous☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Whoops, I'm sorry! Did she startle you?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You're a Trainer from the academy, right☆ 
Did you come looking for marvelous too?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
No worries! It's marvelous even if you 
didn't mean to☆ Because where lots of 
people gather, lots of marvelous gathers 
too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The customers' passion searching for 
marvelous goods! The shopkeepers' passion 
wanting to provide marvelous goods to 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous just keeps calling out to 
marvelous nonstop☆ That's what a shopping 
mall is all about!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Hearing Mave-chan explain it really 
makes it sound convincing, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Look at that balloon art! A dog, a 
cat, and Angkor Wat! Super-duper 
marve-looous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Fufu. Mave-chan really is as 
energetic as ever.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Still, I suppose I should act as her 
proper watchful guardian here.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah... well, you see. Despite how she 
looks, Mave-chan was apparently quite 
frail when she was younger.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Maybe as a reaction to that, she's super 
active now. Always running around happily 
like that—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—She dashes around with everything she 
has, right up to her limit. So when her 
batteries run out, she often collapses on 
the spot.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Still, I think that lively spirit is her 
best charm! So I just want to keep an eye 
on her so she doesn't overdo it and fall 
over.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You two, over here, over here☆ Let's dive 
into the marvelous chaos★

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Oka~y! Coming right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, alongside Sakura Laurel, Marvelous 
Sunday went darting about energetically 
for a while, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eventually her batteries ran dry, and she 
slumped down. She was now taking a short 
break on a bench.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, we walked around a lot, didn't 
we? Once you've rested up, how about we 
hea—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Hmm? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
This feeling of total satisfaction after 
having fun until we're exhausted! It's 
truly marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And to think the world is overflowing with 
enough wonderful things to make us this 
absorbed! Don't you agree it's marvelous!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I-I do think so, but... are you okay, 
Mave-chan!? You shouldn't push yourself 
too hard—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I mean, we get to run through such a 
marvelous world today, tomorrow, and every 
day, right!? When I think about that, 
there's no time to be tired!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I have to find more and more marvelous! 
And share it with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft, fufu. Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. I was just thinking my worries 
were completely unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Experiencing the wonders of the world 
with all her might for as long as she's 
alive. That's Mave-chan's way of life—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—and the very source of her boundless 
energy, isn't it?
choice_data_list:
Maybe we should learn from her 
perspective.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—and the very source of her boundless 
energy, isn't it?
choice_data_list:
Maybe we should learn from her 
perspective.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Now I want to learn more and 
more about marvelous too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Say, Teacher Mave-chan. What kind of 
marvelous is overflowing here?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
For example, that bakery over there! The 
golden-baked crust of the baguettes in the 
basket is marvelous☆ And also—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, the two of them happily 
strolled through the mall together.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ma~~rve~~lous☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... She really is like an endless 
bundle of energy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! I can't let myself fall behind! 
Maybe I'll cut loose and go wild today 
too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, the two of them energetically 
strolled around the mall together.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It really is such a marvelous way to 
live!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Right, right!? You get it, don't you! The 
marvelous energy brimming in this place!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Thanks to you, Mave-chan, I feel 
like I've started sensing it too! This 
feels so very—

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: —Marvelous☆
